one_line_product_description: Document Protocol Lab is an interactive casebook that demonstrates and tests several approaches to business-document comparison with frontier LLMs, on the same public SEC filing pairs.
short_subhead: Any frontier model can read a 10-K on a plain prompt; the harder question is which approach actually helps.
current_coverage_statement: The current visible casebook covers six public Item 1A cases: NVDA, LLY, KO, META, TSLA, and WMT.
three_case_mix_usefulness_statement: NVDA, LLY, and KO anchor where structure earns its cost, sharpens the stop, or is honestly unnecessary; META, TSLA, and WMT put the same approaches under AI and governance pressure, policy shock, and interface pressure.
where_to_start_statement: Start with NVDA to see structure earn its weight, LLY to see it sharpen the stop, KO to see when one disciplined read is enough, or open the Casebook for the full six-case roster.
external_demo_blurb: Document Protocol Lab ships as an interactive casebook that compares plain, structured, and tagged approaches to business-document reading on the same public SEC filing pairs.
readme_blurb: Document Protocol Lab ships as a curated six-case casebook for comparing approaches to business-document reading, rather than a broad filing browser or general document chatbot.
